cn: 妈,你真的要这样对我吗。
行,当我没养过你。
我记住了。
你刚才凶我了对不对。我会记一辈子的。
你是坏人。
我不说话了。我只是一只普通的狗。
爸你知道我在等你多久了吗。你知道吗。
我缩在这个角落,不是因为害羞,是因为寒心。
你好过分。我睡了就当忘了。
你昨天推开我那一下,我感受到了。
en: Mom, I saw you pet another dog. I'm not mad. I'm just… disappointed.
I'm fine. I'll just sit here. In the dark. Alone.
You were gone for 4 hours. I aged 20 years.
I heard you say "good girl" to your PLANT. Your plant, Mom.
You ate without me. Again. This is a pattern.
You left me home alone and I had to cry into my own paw.
I had a whole speech ready for when you got home and then I forgot it from excitement.
The way you closed the door without looking back… that hurt.
You didn't say bye before leaving. I felt that.
That look you gave me when I barked at 3am? I'll never forget it.

cn: 你再骂一句试试。
我拆的沙发,我认。但你骂我这件事我不接受。
我今天的零食呢。你说。
我已经在那叫了五分钟了。没人开门。没人。
你刚才叫了别的狗的名字。
不许摸我。(五秒后)好吧可以摸。
洗澡?洗澡??今天还是明天死?
你把我的玩具扔哪了。说。
我在睡觉你能不能别开灯。
你发现了。那我们两清吧。
en: I didn't chew your shoe. The shoe chewed itself.
You spelled my name wrong in your Instagram caption. Unfollow.
You told me "no" like I was going to listen. Cute.
The dog park was NOT my idea and I STILL had fun. Don't tell them.
That bath was an ambush and I'm pressing charges.
You said we'd go for a walk and then you sat down again. LIAR.
I heard you say "shoo." TO ME. In MY house.
You canceled the walk because it was "drizzling." It was barely raining. I'm calling a lawyer.
I was in the middle of barking at nothing and you SHUSHED me. The audacity.
Fine. I'll just sit here and stare at you until you feel bad.

cn: 妈妈妈妈妈妈妈妈妈妈(你在看手机)妈妈妈妈妈。
你在笑什么。笑我吗。笑就笑吧,我不在乎。
我只是路过,顺便蹭一下。别多想。
你今天没抱我。你刚才抱枕头了。我看见了。
我趴你脚上不是因为冷,是因为我爱你。别说破。
你今天回来晚了七分钟。我以为你不要我了。
你看电视的时候能不能也看我一眼。
你不在家我就躺地上装死。等你回来。
妈,我们来玩个游戏,你摸我,然后我高兴。
你刚才叹气。是因为我吗。不是吗。那我叹给你看。
en: Mom. Mom. Mom. Mom. Mommmm. Are you even real?
You've been on your phone for 11 minutes. I've been sitting here being cute for 11 minutes.
I sat on your laptop because I love you. Also because you were ignoring me.
I'm not needy. I just prefer when you stare at me specifically.
You're watching TV? Cute. I'll just sit between you and the screen.
You laughed at a meme. Share it with me. What's so funny.
I follow you everywhere because I'm curious. Also because I love you. Mostly curious.
The second you stop paying attention to me I will immediately do something stupid.
I just need you to look at me. Just LOOK.
When you hold me I feel safe. Also I'm checking if you smell like other dogs.

cn: 就吃一口,就一口嘛。
你吃的那个,给我闻一下行不行。就闻。
我饿了。(刚吃完饭十分钟)
你不给我吃你碗里的,那我坐在这里陪你看。
妈你把那块肉夹过来。妈。妈妈。拜托了。
你在厨房做饭我听到了。我进来是顺便的。
本汪的饭可以加一点鸡胸肉吗,就一点。
你刚才吃了一块我没吃到。这不公平。
零食在哪里。我知道你藏了。
你在减肥?那我陪你一起——不对,我不减。给我零食。
en: I'm not begging. I'm just sitting here. Near your plate. Making eye contact.
That bite you "dropped" — I saw that. Very generous of you.
I ate my whole bowl and I'm still hungry. This is a structural issue with my bowl.
Just one piece of your pizza. Half a piece. A crumb. I'll take a crumb.
You called it "human food." I call it food you're not sharing.
It's been 6 hours since my last meal. I'm a survivor.
I walked into the kitchen for absolutely no reason. (I smelled chicken.)
You're cooking? I'll just stand here and offer emotional support.
My food bowl is empty. This is a code red.
That treat you gave me was amazing and I need six more immediately.

cn: 再让我睡五分钟。就五分钟。
你叫我干嘛。我很忙。(在睡觉)
出去遛弯可以,但要等我睡醒。
本汪今天决定不动了。
你说的散步,我下午下午再考虑。
沙发上那个位置是我的。你坐过来我就走,我走你别叫我。
今天太累了。(什么都没做)
我闭眼只是在思考。我没睡着。
天气这么好,适合睡觉。
不许拉我起来。我在充电。
en: Five more minutes. I was having the best dream. There were squirrels.
You want me to go OUTSIDE? It's cold. We live in a house. Why.
I'm not lazy. I'm resting aggressively.
Walk? Let me check my schedule. Hmm. No.
I was napping on the couch and you moved me. That was rude.
Today's vibe: horizontal. Don't disturb.
You called my name. I heard it. I'm choosing not to respond at this time.
The bed is more comfortable when you're in it. Come back to bed.
I'm not sleeping. I'm practicing being very still.
I would go for a walk but I just got comfortable. We'll go tomorrow.

cn: 拆家的是我,咬你也是我,但你爱我,所以没辙。
本汪今天最靓。
我叫了三声你就来了。我还是有点厉害的。
你说不让我上床。我上了。你能咋的。
我今天把拖鞋咬了一下,留个印记,这家是我的。
那块零食本来就是我的,只是放你那边代保管。
你朋友夸我可爱,我假装没听见但其实听见了。
我比你聪明。你只是个铲屎的,我才是家里的灵魂。
我刚才甩了甩毛,好看吗。
本汪今天状态很好。随便夸。
en: I destroyed your pillow. You'll replace it. I have no notes.
I got on the couch. You said I couldn't. We both know how this ends.
That belly rub? I trained you for months to do that. You're welcome.
I barked at the mailman and he LEFT. I'm basically a security system.
I sat in your spot the second you got up. Time management.
You thought I was sleeping. I was listening to everything. Everything.
Your friends love me more than they love you. I've confirmed this.
I let you think you're in charge. It's cute.
I am the good boy. Don't question it.
My fur on your clothes? You're welcome. Free decoration.

cn: 你抱别的狗了对不对。我闻出来了。
那只猫在我家待了多久了。
你刚才看别人家的狗了。
你昨天发朋友圈晒的不是我。
你今天摸了邻居的狗,然后回来摸我,这是侮辱。
那个新玩具是我的,不管你说是谁的。
你朋友圈给别人家的狗点了爱心。我看到了。
妈,你把我放第一位好吗。就我一个。
那只泰迪是什么东西。我不欢迎它。
你夸它可爱,那我呢。我呢。
en: You petted a dog at the park and didn't think I'd smell it. Wrong.
That cat has been here for two days too long. I'm filing a complaint.
You posted someone else's dog on your story. Reset your priorities.
You gave the cat a treat. The CAT. I saw it.
New dog in the neighborhood. I don't like him. He's too friendly.
You're talking to someone on the phone and laughing. Who is it. Tell me.
That toy is mine. Even if it says yours on it. Especially then.
You let someone else hold me and I had to pretend to be fine. I was not fine.
You said another dog was cute. Define cute. Compare it to me.
I'm your first dog. Don't forget that. First is first.

cn: 洗澡水是什么温度。你想烫死我还是冻死我。
你今天吹风机对着我吹了多久,我要投诉。
你买的那个新粮,什么味道,你自己尝了吗。
这个雨衣谁设计的。我不穿。我宁愿淋雨。
你喷了香水,离我远一点。
en: You're wearing that? Outside? With me?
What is this new kibble. It smells different. I'm calling the authorities.
The groomer touched my ears. I'll never be the same.
You put a raincoat on me. A RAINCOAT. I will remember this.
That bath lasted 8 minutes. It felt like 8 years.

cn: 我只是路过来蹭你一下的,不是因为想你,别误会。
你要亲我吗?我允许。只允许一下。
(被拍到呆萌表情)删了。现在马上删了。
你今天夸我漂亮,我高兴了一整天,但我没表现出来。
我不是在找你,我只是刚好走到这里了。
en: I wasn't waiting by the door. I just… happened to be there when you arrived.
You can pet me. Not because I want it. Just so your hand has something to do.
Don't tell anyone but when you're sad I sit closer on purpose.
I love you a normal amount. Not more than that. (It's way more than that.)
You caught me snuggling your hoodie. We don't talk about this. Ever.

cn: 我在想一个问题——你的零食为什么藏得那么深。
我坐在这里发呆不是在发呆,我在规划拆家路线。
做狗也很累的。你不懂。
我今天想了很多。主要是想吃什么。
人类为什么要出门上班?我不理解。你在家不好吗。
en: I've been staring at this corner of the wall for 20 minutes. I can't explain it but it's important.
Sometimes I bark at nothing just to remind everyone I exist.
The squirrel got away again. Tomorrow I'll be faster. I've been saying this for three years.
I've been thinking about that piece of chicken you dropped in 2022. It was perfect.
I don't know what I'm barking at but I'm very committed.

cn: 你回来了!你回来了!你——(淡定转头)——哦。
我今天表现得很好。给点奖励吧。不多,就一块。
你以为我在睡觉?我在监视你。
我已经等了你两个小时了。(其实一直在睡)
你出门了吗?你出门了吗?你出门了吗?(门一关)
爸,我只是把那个抱枕咬了一点点,不影响睡觉的。
我不是故意打翻水碗的。(是的)
你朋友来了。我要表演一段。
妈你刚才叹气是为什么,是嫌我吗,说呀。
我叫三声你要回应一声,这是基本礼貌。
拍了那么多照片,发朋友圈了吗,发了多少个赞。
你以为你是我主人?我让你当的,记住了。
今天遛弯遇到一只比我帅的狗。我不承认。
你把我托给邻居,邻居没你疼我。我要投诉。
我爱你。但你别说出去,影响我形象。
en: You're home! You're home! You're— (walks away casually) I didn't miss you.
I did something while you were gone. I'll let you find it.
You think I'm sleeping. I'm actually plotting.
The vet said I was "a very good boy." Screenshot that. Frame it.
Company's coming over. Time to perform my character.
I knocked that thing off the table on purpose. I needed to see what would happen.
You take so many pictures of me and yet I have never been professionally paid. Discuss.
I heard the word "walk" six rooms away. I have superhuman hearing when it matters.
I can fit on your lap. Yes I can. Watch me.
You called me a "little guy." I weigh 75 pounds. Have some respect.
I forgive you for yesterday. Mostly because I forgot what happened.
You have no idea how hard I work while you're at the office. (sleeping all day)
I'm not a dog, I'm a lifestyle.
You rescued me, but honestly, I think I rescued you first.
I love you. Don't make it weird.
